answer: One defence is Rate-limited identity issuance with per-region quotas: only a hundred new identities per region per epoch, and the oasis of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Because only a hundred new identities per region per epoch, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the vertex for an established agent is already paid and proven. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the plume of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
